title: #453 Dependance on Technology
prompt: Do you agree that people are too dependent on technology?

promptSegments.text: Do you agree that people are too dependent on technology?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology makes people lose basic skills like finding information.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology makes people lose basic skills like finding information.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology changes how people communicate and talk to others.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology changes how people communicate and talk to others.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology helps people live easier lives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology helps people live easier lives.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology helps us learn new things.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology helps us learn new things.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology has changed communication, leading people to rely on gadgets for social interaction, which may weaken face-to-face talking skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology has changed communication, leading people to rely on gadgets for social interaction, which may weaken face-to-face talking skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology affects problem-solving abilities because people often look up answers instead of remembering them, potentially weakening natural problem-solving skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology affects problem-solving abilities because people often look up answers instead of remembering them, potentially weakening natural problem-solving skills.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Technology improves daily routines by helping people manage tasks and access knowledge, such as students using computers for school projects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology improves daily routines by helping people manage tasks and access knowledge, such as students using computers for school projects.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Technology strengthens social bonds by allowing people to stay connected with friends and family across different locations through communication apps.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Technology strengthens social bonds by allowing people to stay connected with friends and family across different locations through communication apps.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.
